text:
Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades , Downgrades & Initiations
$AAPL, $BIIB, $KR, $HUM
Daily HeffX -LTN reviews Wall Street analysts research reports to find new investing and trading ideas for our readers. Some reports cover stocks to buy , and others cover stocks to sell or avoid.
Below is a list of Wall Street’s Top analysts outlook for Key issues for Monday, as follows:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) saw its price target at Loop Capital raised to 210 from 195. That compares with the Wall Street consensus price target of 200.06. Biogen Inc. (NASDAQ:BIIB) was raised to Buy from Neutral at Citigroup. The 52-wk trading range for the biotechnology giant is 249.17 – 370.57. The consensus price target is 349.87. Last Thurday, the company said the new Alzheimer drug it is working on shows the potential to slow the disease.
Kroger Co. (NYSE:KR) was started with a Buy rating at Citigroup. The 52-wk trading range for the grocery giant is 19.69 – 31.35. The consensus price target is set at 30.18
Humana Inc. (NYSE:HUM) saw its price target raised at Piper Jaffray to 350 from 326. That compares with a consensus price target of 319.63. The stock closed Friday at 309.02.
Have a terrific week
Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades, Downgrades & Initiations added by Paul Ebeling on July 9, 2018
